bullets.text: Marcus: funnel query planner changes shipped; P95 on the Globex dataset went from 2.8s to 900ms.
Nina: dashboard sharing modal shipped behind a flag to internal users and three beta customers.
Kevin: EU ingestion incident mitigated; consumer-lag alert threshold cut from 15 to 3 minutes.
Marcus starts the retention cohorts rewrite using the same pattern.
Aman: fixing expiring signed URLs for share previews, and webhook retries with exponential backoff up to 24 hours (~70% done).
Nina starts empty states for the new onboarding flow from Leah's designs.
Kevin reruns the staging backfill today (~6 hours).
Staging warehouse has only 30 of the 90 days of data needed for cohorts work.
Sharing GA is blocked on the signed-URL preview bug Globex found.
Staging Terraform state is locked since Arjun's laptop died mid-apply; Arjun is out until Tuesday.
Aman lands the signed URL fix by Wednesday; Nina rolls sharing to 10% Thursday and GA Friday before lunch.
Kevin sends a consumer-deploy canary proposal by Thursday.
Everyone sends Priya their top tech debt items by Wednesday EOD for Q4 planning.
Weekly engineering standup: progress, blockers, and prep for Q4 planning.
Funnel performance win on the Globex dataset.
Dashboard sharing beta and the gray-box preview bug.
Tuesday's 40-minute EU ingestion delay affecting ~60 customers' alerts.
Webhook retry policy, including handling of 429 responses.
Globex called out the funnel speedup on their renewal call.
Nina joins the on-call rotation next week, paired with Kevin.
Webhook retries merged by Monday the 5th; tech debt items to Priya by Wednesday EOD.

action_items.description: Rerun the staging backfill so staging has 90 days of data
Fix share preview signed URLs (generate on request) by Wednesday
Roll dashboard sharing to 10% Thursday and GA Friday before lunch
Send a canary proposal for Kafka consumer deploys by Thursday
Merge webhook retries (honor Retry-After on 429s) by Monday the 5th
Send Priya top one or two tech debt items by Wednesday EOD
Review apply logs with Kevin and decide on force-unlocking the staging Terraform state
Runbook walkthrough with Nina Thursday at 2 before her first on-call shift

chapters.title: Marcus: funnel performance
chapters.summary: Funnel P95 dropped to 900ms; cohorts work waits on a staging backfill Kevin reruns today.

chapters.title: Nina: sharing beta
chapters.summary: Sharing is in beta; the preview bug needs Aman's signed URL fix before GA Friday.

chapters.title: Kevin: ingestion incident
chapters.summary: A stuck Kafka partition delayed EU events for 40 minutes; the lag alert is tightened and a staging Terraform lock needs resolving.

chapters.title: Aman: webhook retries
chapters.summary: Webhooks will retry with exponential backoff up to 24 hours and respect Retry-After on 429s.

chapters.title: Announcements and recap
chapters.summary: Tech debt items are due before Q4 planning, Nina joins on-call, and Priya recaps owners and dates.

highlights.title: Webhooks fail silently after three retries
Should we retry on 429s?
highlights.note: Answer: respect Retry-After, else back off like a 500.

highlights.title: Force-unlock Terraform if logs are clean

decisions.text: Dashboard sharing rolls out to 10% Thursday and goes GA Friday before lunch, gated on the signed URL fix.
decisions.speaker: nina

decisions.text: Webhook retries respect Retry-After on 429s; otherwise treat them like a 500 with backoff.
decisions.speaker: priya

decisions.text: Consumer-lag alert threshold lowered to 3 minutes, suppressed during the 1:00 to 1:30 UTC compaction window.
decisions.speaker: kevin

decisions.text: Priya will decide on force-unlocking staging Terraform after reviewing apply logs rather than wait for Arjun.
decisions.speaker: priya

decisions.text: Nina joins the on-call rotation next week, paired with Kevin for her first shift.
decisions.speaker: priya
